name: MQTT
description: Send messages to an MQTT server

config.name: URL
config.label: MQTT server URL
config.description: MQTT server URL (use mqtts:// for SSL/TLS connection)

config.name: filterMode
config.label: Filter Mode
config.description: Filter mode to use (all messages, all defined aliases, per alias only)

config.name: baseTopic
config.label: MQTT base topic
config.description: MQTT base topic for PagerMon MQTT messages (defaults to "pagermon")

config.name: retainBaseTopic
config.label: Retain messages
config.description: Enable the retain flag on base topic messages. This is prefered when using with home assistant as otherwise messages will be unknown after a restart

config.name: enableHomeAssistant
config.label: Home Assistant integration
config.description: Enable Home Assistant integration with MQTT discovery

aliasConfig.name: enable
aliasConfig.label: Enable
aliasConfig.description: Enable sending messages that match this alias via MQTT
